name: Animata
summary: Free open-source animated React components (Tailwind) via shadcn registry URLs from animata.design.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free registry components of ~130 listed in llms.txt; not a full inventory.
No paid/Pro tier found on animata.design or codse/animata — pricing=free; nothing gated/unlocked.
Docs usage sometimes imports `@/animata/...`; registry files land under `components/animata/...` — catalog copyCode uses `@/components/animata/...` (path may follow project aliases).
Docs prefer `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://animata.design/r/...`; catalog uses portable `npx shadcn@latest`.
ARCHITECTURE §5 prefers iframe for unusual/tactile motion; all demos are docs iframes (no dynamic-import smoke mounts).
gooey-tabs needs `motion` + `@phosphor-icons/react`; shining-button needs `lucide-react` — install via CLI deps / docs.

components.name: Typing Text
components.summary: Types text character-by-character with optional repeat, cursor, and smooth word mode.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add https://animata.design/r/text/typing-text.json

import TypingText from "@/components/animata/text/typing-text"

<TypingText text="Made with Love" repeat={true} delay={32} />

copyPrompt.text: Use Animata free component `Typing Text` (slug `typing-text`) from https://animata.design/docs/text/typing-text. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://animata.design/r/text/typing-text.json` (docs often show `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add ...`). Registry item: https://animata.design/r/text/typing-text.json. Import from `@/components/animata/text/typing-text` after CLI add (path may follow project aliases; some docs use `@/animata/...`). Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS. All Animata components researched are free & open source (MIT — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codse/animata/main/LICENSE.md); prefer free-tier only.

import { HouseIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react"

    <GooeyTabs.Tab color="bg-violet-500 hover:bg-violet-600" label="Home">
      <GooeyTabs.Icon>

      </GooeyTabs.Icon>
